# githubevent

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-controller/internal/domains/githubevent"
```

Package githubevent implements the GitHubEvent resource domain.

The GitHubEvent domain is responsible for managing the lifecycle of GitHubEvent resources. It receives commands from the Engine, resolves resource specifications into validated contracts, delegates processing to the application layer, and records reconciliation outcomes through conditions and events.
